source_coverage.reason: The repository and mounted project outputs have been inventoried conservatively, but the owner has not confirmed that they exhaust all historical execution locations or reviewed every excluded format.

explicit_exclusions.reason: Binary spreadsheet is inventoried and hash-bound but this seed scanner does not interpret workbook cells.
Binary spreadsheet is inventoried and hash-bound but this seed scanner does not interpret workbook cells.
Rendered documentation is inventoried and hash-bound; its tracked source documents are scanned separately.

tracked_repository.rule: Every Git-tracked path is inventoried. JSON/JSONL/CSV and declared text formats, including Python, shell and JavaScript scripts, are content-scanned. Unsupported binary files require exact path, content SHA-256, reason and explicit coverage disposition; unlisted formats fail closed.

external_execution_locations.coverage_decision: Confirm whether every Snellius or other remote-HPC seed-bearing manifest and log has been copied into the mounted outputs scope; otherwise add a hash-bound source.
Confirm whether every cloud/VM run seed-bearing manifest and log has been copied into the mounted outputs scope; otherwise add a hash-bound source.
Review backups and provenance records for deleted local runs and record either recovered evidence or a signed no-recovery disposition.
Ask collaborators whether they hold seed-bearing run artifacts not present in the mounted repository outputs and bind any supplied evidence by hash.

outputs.root_scope: Only the explicitly mounted project outputs/ tree; no parent directories, home-directory search, or unrelated private data.
outputs.csv_rule: Inspect every CSV header and parse only files with seed-like columns; files without seed-like columns are inventoried but not content-scanned.

limitations: The mounted outputs tree is not asserted to include deleted, remote, cloud, HPC, or collaborator-held runs; each class has an explicit unresolved coverage decision above.
Raw output JSON files whose basenames do not match the declared metadata patterns are inventoried but not content-scanned; many are large repeated candidate records.
Archives, spreadsheets, PDFs, NPZ files, images, and other binary formats are inventoried but not opened. Their seed provenance remains unresolved unless separately reviewed.
Textual seed mentions, ranges, formulas, and seed-like epidemiological parameter names are never silently converted into RNG seeds.
This inventory does not allocate, recommend, reserve, or authorize any seed block or model execution.
